locations.title: Rat Form
locations.description:
**Type:** Vampire Power  
**Affinity:** None  
**Effect:** Turn into a small rat and blend into the environment making it harder for enemies to detect you.  Taking damage breaks the effect.

**How to Unlock:** Defeat the [Putrid Rat](#loc=178456)

locations.title: Corpse Explosion
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Unholy  
**Effect:** Raise a bone pile from below that explodes at the target dealing 125% magic damage and applies a fading snare that lasts for 1s.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Goreswine the Ravager (27)](#loc=178447)

locations.title: Veil of Bones
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Unholy  
**Effect:** Dash towards input direction and elude nearby enemies for 2.2s.  Your next attack launches a projectile  that deals 25% magic damage, bouncing up to 4 targets and inflicts amplify that increases damage taken by 25% for 5s.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Goreswine the Ravager (27)](#loc=178447)

locations.title: Frost Bat
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Frost  
**Effect:** Launch a projectile that explodes upon impact, dealing 100% magic damage and inflicts Chill on surrounding enemies.  Hitting a chilled enemy freezes it for 4s.  Enemy vampires are frozen for 2.5s.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Keely the Frost Archer (20)](#loc=178445)

locations.title: Wolf Form
locations.description:
**Type:** Vampire Power  
**Affinity:** None  
**Effect:** Turn into a swift creature increasing your movement speed by 45%.  Taking damage breaks the effect.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Alpha Wolf  (16)](#loc=178446)

locations.title: Blood Rage
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Blood  
**Effect:** Shield self and nearby allies for 110% of your spell power and increase attack speed by 25% for 4.5s.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Rufus the Foreman (20)](#loc=178449)

locations.title: Aftershock
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Chaos  
**Effect:** Smash the ground , causing a shockwave that erupts, dealing 100% magic damage in a line and inflicting Chaos Burn.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Errol the Stonebreaker (20)](#loc=178451)

locations.title: Chaos Volley
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Chaos  
**Effect:** Launch 2 Chaos Bolts in a sequence that deals 125% magic damage and inflicts Chaos Burn.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Lidia the Chaos Archer (26)](#loc=178452)

locations.title: Bear Form
locations.description:
**Type:** Vampire Power  
**Affinity:** None  
**Effect:** Turn into a powerful creature able to destroy massive resources.  Increases your resistances by 25, movement speed by 15% and reduces damage taken by 25%.  You regenerate health slightly quicker while in this form.

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Ferocious Bear (36)](#loc=178384)

locations.title: Human Form
locations.description:
**Type:** Vampire Power  
**Affinity:** None  
**Effect:** Turn into a human allowing you to sneak around unnoticed in human settlements.  Be careful though, the strong-willed can see through your disguise.  While in human form you can interact with traders.  Human Form greatly increases blood consumption rate.

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Beatrice the Tailor (38)](#loc=178468)

locations.title: Veil of Chaos
locations.description:
**Type:** Travel Ability  
**Affinity:** Chaos  
**Effect:** Dash towards input direction and elude nearby enemies for 2.2s.  Your next melee attack deals 25% bonus damage.  Can be recasted to dash once more spawning a second illusion.  Your illusions explode dealing 50% magic damage to nearby enemies.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Clive the Firestarter (30)](#loc=178454)

locations.title: Spectral Wolf
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Illusion  
**Effect:** Send out a Spectral Wolf that deals 100% magic damage, inflicts a fading snare and weakens the target reducing damage output by 30% for 5s.  It bounces to a nearby enemy after each hit, up to 2 hits.  Each hit deals 75% less damage.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Polora the Feywalker (34)](#loc=178262)

locations.title: Veil of Illusion
locations.description:
**Type:** Travel Ability  
**Affinity:** Illusion  
**Effect:** Dash towards input direction and elude nearby enemies for 2.2s.  Your next primary attack deal 25% bonus damage.  Spawns an illusion that throws projectiles that deal 40% magic damage.  Recast to return to your start position and spawn a new illusion at your current location.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Polora the Feywalker (34)](#loc=178262)

locations.title: Power Surge
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Chaos  
**Effect:** Remove all negative effects and apply a shield on target ally or self that shields the target for 150% of your spell power.  Increases movement speed by 25% and attack speed by 25% while the shield lasts.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Azariel the Sunbringer (68)](#loc=178466)

locations.title: Purgatory
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Unholy  
**Effect:** Call down a pillar of energy that slows enemies in an area for 1s and heals allies for 40% of you spell power.  After 1.2s the pillar erupts in a powerful burst of energy dealing 75% magic damage to enemies and healing allies for 75% of your spell power.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Christina the Sun Priestess (44)](#loc=178472)

locations.title: Mist Trance
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Illusion  
**Effect:** Block melee and projectile attacks for up to 1.5s.  Turn non- material and teleport to cursor location when an attack is blocked.  Resets the cooldown of your Secondary Weapon attack.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Foulrot the Soultaker (62)](#loc=178457)

locations.title: Ice Nova
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Frost  
**Effect:** Summon a nova of ice at the target locaiton dealing 100% magic damage and freezing any enemy already affected by Chill for 4s.  The nova radiates outward inflicting Chill for 5s to any enemy hit.  Enemy vampires are frozen for 2.5s.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Frostmaw the Mountain Terror (56)](#loc=178467)

locations.title: Crimson Aegis
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Blood  
**Effect:** Apply a shield to target ally or self that shields the target for 200% of your spell power.  Knocks nearby enemies back when the shield is applied.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Grayson the Armourer (27)](#loc=178453)

locations.title: Chaos Barrage
locations.description:
**Type:** Ultimate Ability  
**Affinity:** Chaos  
**Effect:** Launch 4 Chaos Orbs that deal 75% magic damage on direct hit, 75% magic damage to enemies in an area and inflicts Chaos Burn.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Jade the Vampire Hunter (62)](#loc=178473)

locations.title: Spectral Assassin
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Illusion  
**Effect:** Summon a Spectral Assassin at target location that performs a heavy melee attack dealing 125% magic damage to nearby enemies, knocking them back and weakening them, reducing damage output by 30% for 5s.  Last for up to 6s.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Leandra the Shadow Priestess (46)](#loc=178470)

locations.title: Crystal Lance
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Frost  
**Effect:** Launch a projectile dealing 150% magic damage and inflicting Chill.  Hitting a chilled enemy freezes it for 4s.  The Crystal Lance splinters into a nova of projectiles on impact, each splinter deals 50% magic damage, chilling or freezing targets as well.  Enemy vampires are frozen for 2.5s.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Mairwyn the Elementalist (64)](#loc=178464)

locations.title: Unstable Mosquito
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Unholy  
**Effect:** Summon a mosquito that chases an enemy and explodes after 1s.  Deals 60% magic damage in an area and inflicts Amplify that increases damage taken by 25% for 5s.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Matka the Curse Weaver (72)](#loc=178460)

locations.title: Sanguine Coil
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Blood  
**Effect:** Launch a projectile that deals 75% magic damage and leeches 40% health on enemy hit.  Heals ally for 100% and self for 40% of your spell power on ally hit.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Meredith the Bright Archer (52)](#loc=178311)

locations.title: Void
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Chaos  
**Effect:** Summon an orb that explodes at the target location, dealing 70% magic damage and inflicting Chaos Burn.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Morian the Stormwing Matriarch (68)](#loc=178465)

locations.title: Pestilence
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Unholy  
**Effect:** Launch a wave of 3 unholy projectiles that each deal 40% magic damage, knocks target back and inflict Amplify that increases damage taken by 25% for 5s.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Nicholaus the Fallen (37)](#loc=178450)

locations.title: Ward of the Damned
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Unholy  
**Effect:** Increase movement speed by 10% and block melee and projectile attacks in front of you for 2s.  Each absorbed attack summons a skeleton.  Enemy melee attackers are knocked back.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Nicholaus the Fallen (37)](#loc=178450)

locations.title: Bat Form
locations.description:
**Type:** Vampire Power  
**Affinity:** None  
**Effect:** Turn into a bat and fly high into the air allowing you to cross impassable terrain.  Cannot be used while carrying resources, while indoors and requires a valid landing location when exiting the form.  Beware of the sun!  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Nightmarshal Styx the Sunderer (76)](#loc=178461)

locations.title: Mirror Strike
locations.description:
**Type:** Ultimate Ability  
**Affinity:** Illusion  
**Effect:** Dash forward and bounce between nearby enemies striking them for a total of 600% magic damage split across targets within the area over 3s.  Weakens target hit by 30% for 5s.  Afterward, dash towards your aim direction.  Recast to end this effect early.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Octavian the Militia Captain (58)](#loc=178469)

locations.title: Chaos Barrier
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Chaos  
**Effect:** Increase movement speed by 10% and block melee and projectile attacks in front of you for 2s.  Blocking an attack launches a projectile towards the attacker dealing 75% damage, pushing the target towards you and inflicting Chaos Burn.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Quincy the Bandit King (37)](#loc=178444)

locations.title: Merciless Charge
locations.description:
**Type:** Ultimate Ability  
**Affinity:** Chaos  
**Effect:** Charge forward and grab an enemy dealing 125% magic damage, and push them in front of you. Deals 100% magic area damage and inflicts a Stun lasting 1,5s when reaching maximum range or when colliding with another enemy or object.

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Quincy the Bandit King (37)](#loc=178444)

locations.title: Crimson Beam
locations.description:
**Type:** Ultimate Ability   
**Affinity:** Blood  
**Effect:** Channel a beam of energy that deals 150% magic damage to enemies hit, and heals allies for 100% of your spell power per second for up to 4s.  Each target hit heals self for 25% of your spell power.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Raziel the Shepherd (60)](#loc=178475)

locations.title: Spectral Guardian
locations.description:
**Type:** Ultimate  
**Affinity:** Illusion  
**Effect:** Summon a Spectral Guardian that shields allies in  an area for 125% of your spell power and attacks enemies with a mighty swing.  The shield is reapplied every 1.5s.  The golem lasts for 7s.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Terah the Geomancer (48)](#loc=178471)

locations.title: Arctic Leap
locations.description:
**Type:** Ultimate Ability  
**Affinity:** Frost  
**Effect:** ??  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Terrorclaw the Ogre (68)](#loc=178281)

locations.title: Toad Form
locations.description:
**Type:** Vampire Power  
**Affinity:** None  
**Effect:** Turn into a toad able to jump high into the air.  Taking damage breaks the effect.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [The Duke of Balaton (62)](#loc=178459)

locations.title: Blood Hunger
locations.description:
**Type:** Vampire Power  
**Affinity:** None  
**Effect:** Allows you to instantly recognize blood type and blood quality of nearby units.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Tristan the Vampire Hunter (46)](#loc=178455)

locations.title: Volatile Arachnid
locations.description:
**Type:** Ultimate Ability  
**Affinity:** Unholy  
**Effect:** Summon spiderlings that chase down your enemy and explode when nearby dealing 100% magic damage.  Spawns a toxic fume that deals 20% magic damage every 0.8s while slowing enemies by -25%.  Can be recast up to 3 times.

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Ungora the Spider Queen (60)](#loc=178458)

locations.title: Frost Barrier
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Frost  
**Effect:** Increase movement speed by 10% and block melee and projectile attacks in front of you for 2s.  Spawn up to 8 waves of frost dealing 50% magic damage and inflicting Chill when the barrier is struck.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Vincent the Frostbringer (40)](#loc=178474)

locations.title: Veil of Frost
locations.description:
**Type:** Travel Ability  
**Affinity:** Frost  
**Effect:** Dash towards input direction, elude nearby enemies for 2.2s and shield self for 125% of your spell power.  Your next primary attack deals 25% bonus damage and conjures a nova of frost dealing 50% magic damage and inflicting chill on nearby enemies.

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Vincent the Frostbringer (40)](#loc=178474)

locations.title: Heart Strike
locations.description:
**Type:** Ultimate Ability  
**Affinity:** Blood  
**Effect:** Dash forward and strike enemies in a line.  Deals 150% magic damage and heals self for 150% of your spell power over 3.5s.  A nova of blood erupts when the effect ends dealing 150% magic damage to the victim and nearby enemies.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Willfred the Werewolf Chief (64)](#loc=178476)

locations.title: Summon Fallen Angel
locations.description:
**Type:** Ultimate Ability  
**Affinity:** Unholy  
**Effect:** Summons a fallen angel to fight for you for 15s.  Attacks made by the fallen angel inflict amplify that increases damage taken by 25% for 5s.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Solarus the Immaculate (80)](#loc=178463)

locations.title: Frost Vortex
locations.description:
**Type:** Ultimate Ability  
**Affinity:** Frost  
**Effect:** Conjure a frost storm that deals 100% magic damage and pulls enemies towards the center.  The storm rages on for 6s, dealing 480% magic damage and inflicting Chill on all enemies.  

**How to Unlock:** Unlock [Bat Form](#loc=178813) from [Nightmarshal Styx the Sunderer](#loc=178461) and use it to land on [The Dreaded Peak](#loc=178385) and kill [The Winged Horror](#loc=178448).

locations.title: Wisp Dance
locations.description:
**Type:** Basic Ability  
**Affinity:** Illusion  
**Effect:** Summon three wisps that circle around you, dealing 25% magic damage to enemies.  Recast to launch all three wisps as projectiles dealing 50% magic damage and weakening the target reducing damage output by 30% for 5s.  

**How to Unlock:** Defeat [Gorecrusher the Behemoth (78)](#loc=178462)
